name: reVC
summary: reVC (Reverse Engineered Vice City) is an open-source project that recreates the game engine of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City through reverse engineering. The project aims to reproduce the functionality of the original game while allowing community-developed fixes, improvements, modifications, and new features that are difficult or impossible to implement in the original release. reVC does not include the proprietary game data and assets from Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, so the original game files are required to use it.
